name: Will of the Jeskai
clause: • Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. • The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.

needs.semantics: Write an alternative cost onto another object for a duration — 'gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.' `altCosts` today is a static declaration on a CardDef only; nothing grants one. cost:'its-mana-cost' covers the common self-referential wording.
